audience: researchers and health writers who look for studies on ClinicalTrials.gov

useCases.title: Find trials for a condition, place and status
useCases.text: The AI searches the registry by condition, intervention, sponsor or location and filters by status or geography. You get a list of matching studies.

useCases.title: Read the full record of one trial by NCT ID
useCases.text: The AI fetches a study by its NCT id. It can return only chosen fields, so you can read eligibility rules or outcomes of that trial.

useCases.title: Count the trials that match a topic
useCases.text: The AI returns only the number of studies for a condition, intervention, sponsor, location or status. You see how big a research area is.

useCases.title: Sort trials by enrollment or latest update
useCases.text: The AI searches studies and sorts them, for example by enrollment count or last update date. It sums up the largest or most recently updated trials of a sponsor or condition.

useCases.title: Look up valid status and phase values for a search
useCases.text: The AI lists the values used in fields such as status or phase, and shows the study data model. You can then build a correct filter.
